buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The TERMS AND CONDITIONS of the contract are as under :- 1. Vehicle is to be hired along with Driver from the owner of the company. 2. The rates quoted should include all forms of taxes/charges. 3. JNVs will bear only the cost of diesel for the distance actually plied for official use for which a log book wi ll be maintained by the Driver and Principal will certify the same. All other liabilities including wages of driv er, oil and lubricants, maintenance, repair, replacement of parts and servicing obligations on account of M otor Vehicle Act and other related Acts like Labour Laws, Road Tax, Insurance Laws (like insurance of vehic le in accident, theft, fire etc.) shall be the sole responsibility of the owner of the company. 4. The vehicle shall be hired on 24 hours basis. 5. Vehicle to be hired should be of latest model, preferably not more than 02 years old. 6. The vehicle should have capacity to carry up to 5 persons having a comfortable seat for carrying a sick c hild. 7. Payment will be made out of contingency grant of Vidyalaya on a monthly basis subject to applicable TD S. 8. Vehicle will be parked in the Vidyalaya premises only at the risk of the owner of the company. 9. The driver of the vehicle can be provided accommodation in the JNV wherever possible subject to availa bility of accommodation; otherwise the arrangements will be made by the owner of the company within ap proachable distance from the Vidyalaya. 10. Maximum one day per month i.e., 10 days in a year shall be permitted for maintenance/servicing. The vehicle shall not be sent for repairs for more than four days at a stretch. Alternate vehicle shall be provide d by the owner in case the non-availability is for the period exceeding the specified period mentioned abov e. Failure to provide alternate vehicle shall lead to recovery of actual hiring charges per day paid by JNV. 11. Use of the vehicle will be restricted as per guidelines of Samiti and for Vidyalaya purposes only. 12. The rates so revised would be the maximum but the lowest rate as per tender or as decided by the PAC of the JNV depending upon the condition of the vehicle would prevail but in no case the hiring charges sho

uld be more than the revised ceiling. 13. One month's hiring cost is to be kept as Security Deposit from the successful bidder, which will be refu nded after satisfactory completion of the contract. 14. The vehicle is provided to meet exigencies of services for students and staff. In addition to this, Princip al/office can also utilize it for the official purpose. 15. The vehicle hired shall have valid taxi permit for entire period of hiring. 16 The vehicle hired shall have valid insurance for entire period of hiring. 17. The fuel consumption average of the vehicle hired shall be got certified from the Company/authorised dealer of the vehicle. Charges for fuel will be borne by JNV strictly as per the certified average. However, a verage (Diesel vehicle) of less than 14 KM per litre in JNVs of normal terrain and less than 12 KM/litre in hill y terrain will not be accepted. A particular JNV is situated in hilly terrain or otherwise, it will be certified by the concerned Regional Office. 18. Inter District movement of Vidyalaya vehicle shall be justified by the Principal. 19. Log book of vehicle shall be maintained by driver of the vehicle and each individual entry shall be certi fied by the user of vehicle and both co-signatories of financial powers. Similarly, log book of the electric DG set shall be maintained by ECP and each entry shall be verified by both co-signatories. 20. Valid driving license of the driver and character verification by police shall be made available to Vidyal aya. 21. Vehicle hiring is to be done by following latest GFR instructions. 22. The Agency should have to submit valid proof of Bank Account Number, PAN Card, GST Certificate and undertaking that firm has not been blacklisted. 23. Right to Terminate/Cancel the Contract The Principal, PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Paota (Kotputli-Beh ror), reserves the right to terminate or cancel the contract at any time by servin g written notice to the Service Provider if the services rendered, vehicle conditio n, or conduct and performance of the driver are found unsatisfactory. However, in cases involving gross negligence, safety violations, violation of POCSO-relate d requirements, or unauthorized absence, the Vidyalaya shall have the right to t erminate the contract with immediate effect, without waiting for the notice peri od, subject to applicable rules and due process. 24. No Compensation for the Unexpired Contract Period In the event of termination or cancellation of the contract due to unsatisfactory performance, negligence, or breach of contractual conditions by the Service Pro vider, payment shall be made strictly on a pro-rata basis for the actual verified period of satisfactory services rendered up to the date of termination. The Servi ce Provider shall not be entitled to claim any compensation, damages, loss of pr ofit, or other payment for the unexpired period of the contract. 25. the event of termination or cancellation due to unsatisfactory performance, negligence, or breach of an y contractual condition, the Vidyalaya reserves the right to forfeit the Security Deposit/ePBG, equivalent to one month's hiring charges, either wholly or partly, as applicable under the tender conditions and subject t o due process. Further, the Vidyalaya shall be entitled to arrange an alternative vehicle at the r isk and cost of the defaulting Service Provider, recover any additional expenditu re incurred, and report the contractual default as an Incident on the GeM Portal for appropriate action in accordance with applicable GeM terms and conditions. 26. All legal disputes, claims, or proceedings arising out of or relating to this tender/contract shall be subje

ct to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts at Kotputli-Behror (Rajasthan) only, and no other court shall have jurisdiction in the matter. 27. The required vehicle will have to be supplied by the agency within 5 days o f the award of the contract failing which the contract can be cancelled. 28. Failure to submit the valid ePBG / Security Deposit within the stipulated 05 d ays shall be treated as a breach of tender conditions, entitling the Vidyalaya to cancel the contract immediately, award the work to the next eligible bidder (or re-tender at the defaulting bidder's risk and cost), and raise a formal Incident o n the GeM portal against the defaulting Service Provider 29. Demand Draft (EMD & ePBG) should in favour of Principal, Jawahar Navoday a Vidyalaya, Paota Bank Name- Union Bank of India, Paota . 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support.
